candidate.application: Add the frozen 2,001-sample Fahrenheit residual distribution to each protected expanding-Ridge point prediction; no protected refit or rescaling.

protected_point_generation.procedure: Same station-specific daily expanding Ridge alpha 100, 48 features, target-minus-one 18:00 LST cutoff, minimum 18 distinct temperature hours, and null-target NO_SCORE contract.
protected_point_generation.online_update: After a target date is predicted and observed, its eligible labeled row joins the station history for the next target date.

development_only_baseline_calibration.sources: The same six development prediction files and checksums in EXP-20260912-probability-candidate-selection-v1.
development_only_baseline_calibration.persistence_gaussian: For every protected persistence point, add Gaussian quantiles using the pooled development persistence error mean and population standard deviation.
development_only_baseline_calibration.harmonic_empirical: For every protected expanding harmonic point, add the 2,001 deterministic quantiles of pooled development harmonic-climatology errors without jitter.

scoring.candidate_and_baselines: Identical 2,001-sample CRPS, 20F..120F two-degree bins with tails, 1e-6 bin floor and renormalization.
scoring.best_baseline_for_crps: Whichever of persistence Gaussian and harmonic empirical has lower pooled protected CRPS; this single baseline supplies every row's paired bootstrap comparator.
scoring.best_baseline_for_log_loss: Whichever baseline has lower pooled protected categorical log loss.
scoring.station_positive_skill: Candidate station CRPS lower than the better station-level CRPS of the two baselines.
scoring.pit_ece: Candidate randomized-free empirical PIT rank in ten equal-width bins; ECE is total variation distance from the uniform ten-bin distribution.

bootstrap.unit: target_date across all protected stations available on that date

decision_rule.all_gates_pass: PROTECTED_PROBABILITY_PASS; weather probability model may proceed to a separately preregistered market-incremental evaluation.
decision_rule.any_gate_fails: PROTECTED_PROBABILITY_FAIL; do not tune or recalibrate on KBOS/KPHX/KDEN outcomes.
